title: 油价跌回每桶98美元 沙特有望重启管道
summary: 此前油价一度飙升至每桶109.97美元，原因是在一系列无人机袭击破坏东西向输油管道后，沙特阿拉伯在近两周前关闭了该管道。

title: 中國希望伊朗戰爭結束，但不是以特朗普想要的方式
summary: 分析人士指，北京可能推動德黑蘭重啟談判，但不太可能停止購買伊朗石油。

title: 特朗普敦促泽连斯基停止袭击俄炼油厂
summary: 美国总统将全球柴油价格上涨归咎于俄乌战争，而非他发动的美伊冲突。据悉他向乌方传递的核心信息是“柴油、柴油、柴油”。

title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
summary: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
summary: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
summary: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

title: Inside Djibouti refugee camp for thousands fleeing Houthi advance in Yemen
summary: Fighting on Yemen's west coast has prompted thousands of people to flee by boat across the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
